character: A large high-altitude ski area in the Paznaun valley of western Tyrol, linked across the Swiss border with duty-free Samnaun and sold on one ticket as the Silvretta Arena. Most of the skiing lies above 2,000 m and is reached by gondolas from Ischgl village, and the resort is known for its lively après-ski.
learning: Reference note: ski schools and nursery areas exist in Ischgl and Samnaun, but most of the terrain is red and black, so it suits confident intermediates best. Confirm beginner areas and lesson products.

research.confidenceNotes: Refreshed 2026-10-03 by web search only (page fetches blocked by the network proxy; every fact is search-summary). The web-search budget ran out during this resort. Coordinates, operator and weather points remain Piste reference data. Adversarial re-check 2026-10-03: WebFetch and web search were both unavailable, so no cited page could be reopened. Adult/senior EUR 83, child EUR 51 (2026-27) and the Nov 26, 2026 – May 2, 2027 dates were also found by the separate 2026-09-30 search.
